description: This file defines the GameBoard widget for a word guessing game (similar to Wordle). It renders a 6x5 grid of guesses, current input, and empty rows, managing layout and tile states.

classes.name: GameBoard
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that renders a 6x5 grid for user guesses, current input, and empty rows, with responsive layout.

methods.name: GameBoard
methods.description: Constructor for GameBoard widget, initializing guesses, current input, word length, and max attempts.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, generating rows for guesses, current input, or empty slots, and lays them out within the available constraints.

methods.name: _buildRow
methods.description: Creates a row of LetterTile widgets based on provided string content and tile states, sizing tiles according to available space.
